description: Representative speakers for the compare-voices skill: one male and one female per voice outcome, each with a real in-game line from the OSRS wiki transcript named in source.

cases.name: Hans
cases.line: You are in Lumbridge Castle, in the Kingdom of Misthalin. Across the river, the road leads north to Varrock, and to the west lies Draynor Village.

cases.name: Aggie
cases.line: I pick mine from the woods south of Varrock. The food shop in Port Sarim sometimes has some as well.

cases.name: Wydin
cases.line: We have this really exotic fruit all the way from Karamja. It's called a banana.

cases.name: Hetty
cases.line: You need an eye of newt, a rat's tail, an onion... Oh and a piece of burnt meat.

cases.name: Edmond
cases.line: If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.

cases.name: Elena
cases.line: Go and see my father, I'll make sure he adequately rewards you. Now I'd better leave while I still can.

cases.name: Guildmaster Lars
cases.line: My name is Lars, and I am the founder of the woodcutting guild. I originally grew up in a Shayzien camp, and was raised on the battlefield.

cases.name: Captain Ginea
cases.line: Gangs. It's the gangs from the slums in the east. Those ruffians are always hatching schemes, whether it's smuggling or extortion or even plain street violence.

cases.name: Mandrith
cases.line: I collect valuable resources and pawn off access to them to foolish adventurers, like yourself.

cases.name: Krystilia
cases.line: Before I assign you anything, I want to make something clear. My tasks have to be done in the Wilderness. Only kills inside the Wilderness will count.

cases.name: Regulus Cento
cases.line: Nilsal, adventurer. The name is Regulus Cento, one of the quetzal keepers for the Royal Family of Varlamore.

cases.name: Guildmaster Apatura
cases.line: Well, I'm Apatura. Let me welcome you to our small corner of Varlamore.

cases.name: Ali Morrisane
cases.line: Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.

cases.name: Leela
cases.line: My suggestion is that you pretend to be interested in joining her bandits. From there, you should be able to steer the conversation towards the key.

cases.name: Dr Fenkenstrain
cases.line: I'm sorry, but I don't think you have the aptitude for this position.

cases.name: Alice
cases.line: The curse of undeath was so cruel; all the men out here succumbed, but Lyra and I were left alive.

cases.name: Shanomi
cases.line: A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.

cases.missing: no Human Female with ethnicity easternlands in npc-voices.json (only males Shanomi and Ak-Haranu)

cases.name: Brimstail
cases.line: It's always a pleasure to catch up with an another mage! Especially one who has helped me so much!

cases.name: Femi
cases.line: Could you help me lift these boxes? They are really heavy!

cases.name: Nulodion
cases.line: Hmmmmmm... I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!

cases.name: Agmundi
cases.line: If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.

cases.name: Orlando Smith
cases.line: But to be deadset with you, I wasn't paying much attention to me boss over there and I've done a bit of a rush job.

cases.missing: byId 6001 (Orlando Smith) is the only Australian NPC and is male

cases.name: Hari
cases.line: I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?

cases.missing: byId 1325 (Hari) is the only New Zealand NPC and is male

cases.name: Sigmund The Merchant
cases.line: Hello outerlander. By the laws of our tribe, I am afraid I may not speak to you without the express permission of the chieftain.

cases.name: Yrsa
cases.line: I'm sorry outerlander, I cannot sell you any clothes. Our customs forbid it.

cases.name: Awowogei
cases.line: I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.

cases.name: Hamab
cases.line: Would you like to buy or sell some crafting equipment?

cases.name: General Bentnoze
cases.line: We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour. Brown get boring after a bit. We want change.

cases.name: Zanik
cases.line: A giant frog found its way into the mines, but I helped the guards to drive it off!

cases.name: Dad
cases.line: What tiny human do in troll arena? Dad challenge human to fight!

cases.name: Aga
cases.line: I not know if he love Aga, He say he will show he love by bringing me flower Trollweiss.

cases.name: Schoolboy
cases.line: I wanna be an archaeologist when I grow up!

cases.name: Schoolgirl
cases.line: Teacher! Can we go to the Natural History exhibit now?

cases.name: Ali the Leaflet Dropper
cases.line: I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
Traiborn digs around in the pockets of his robes. After a few moments he triumphantly presents you with a spinach roll.
